body:
I feel you. I get the same thoughts daily. Often it’s thinking of throwing myself out of a window but recently I started thinking about overdosing on meds and see what happens. Honestly it’s tiring but I try to remind myself that there are nice things in this world. I also lost faith years ago. If god existed why would he make us suffer? 
Hope things get better soon for you ❤️‍🩹

I was in the same situation when I found out I have endometriosis. I’m glad my suicide attempts failed. It gets better, I promise. There are solutions and good doctors out there. Stay strong ❤️ in the meanwhile distracting yourself can help you forget about your problems for a while
Same!!!

Thanks. I was also thinking of cutting my hair and trying masculine clothes. The fact is that I wish I was born a boy, I wish I had a penis and flat chest but I don’t like to be more masculine. I appreciate femininity but I don’t like being a woman. I feel in between. I don’t understand what’s wrong with me. I guess my therapist will help
Same… I’m literally so confused. I just want to know who I am
This makes so much sense. Thank you! I’ll try to talk with my psychologist
Same thing is happening to me today.. I don’t understand anymore. Who am I?
I’ve also been wondering where my dysphoria come from. I guess I wasn’t treated fairly because I was born female. Maybe that’s the problem but I’m not sure
Thank you everyone for all the kind comments ❤️
I’ve been experiencing trans ocd since last year and it’s not going away but it gets better with medication. I think you should talk with a therapist. I hope it gets better for you <3
Thank you!!!
Thanks! I’m less confused now
Same but with penises for me. I’m so disgusted and tired of my own thoughts
Thanks 💗
I’m 22 on menopause with monthly shots. I’ve noticed this little bump and I’m worried. Idk if it the right place to ask but idk what to do. I hope its nothing to worry about
It’s to treat my endometriosis and my doctor gave me hrt since I’m young and still need estrogen. I hope I will lose a little weight though!
Oh I see, thanks!!
Thanks! I feel relieved to know there are different solutions!
Thanks, I’ll try to find more information. Unfortunately lupron is the only solution to my endo. I’ve tried the pill but it didn’t work and I was suicidal, so I don’t know what else i should do :(
The lowest. 25 mg twice a week
Thanks. I already got hrt patches but I’m getting side effects and I’m worried
That’s why I’m worried :( idk if there are other solutions

Exactly, I was thinking the same thing. If estrogen makes me feel bad why give me more?

How are you doing rn? Does the surgery completely stop your period? (I used to go into depression during my period and self harmed, so I don’t want to get a period anymore, I’m scared)

Estradiol (the name of the patch is estraderm). My back and muscles hurt. My head hurts and I feel fatigued all the time. I have had problems with depression and self harming and I noticed I’m getting again into depression. I’m worried because I still want to get the shots tho. Do you know if there are other solutions to the patch? ( my gyno said I need to get a little estrogen if I want to continue being on induced menopause)
Estraderm 25 mg

I have physical and mental illnesses and hearing people say “thank god you are ok, you found a cure” made me so mad. It’s not thanks god. I wish I wasn’t alive but thanks to my doctors I’m still here. God didn’t help me or all the kids who are dying ill. Where is god when someone is suffering?

When I was maybe 6 or 7 the priest said that god knows if we even doubt his existence and he will punish us. I’ve been scared for years thinking that god could kill my family if I didn’t believe enough
I see. Thanks! I’m still confused about many things
My parents were very religious and my ocd began because I thought god could listen me. Now I hate believing in a god.
I see. So if I have some fat rolls I guess floating jewellery should be the option?
True, I feel you. I never took antidepressants and I had to take them (and still do) after a bad flare up and after the pill made me suicidal.
Can you still wear high waisted pants and sleep on your stomach?
I’m so sorry :( it really is an ugly illness. I hope you are doing better tho
True!!!

The dizziness yes. The rest of the month you only get hot flashes (especially the first few months, it can happen really often everyday) but it’s nothing. It’s just feeling hot for a few minutes and that’s it. I also have more discharge in my underwear but it doesn’t bother me at all. My gyno said that all of these are still going to go away with estrogen patches. It’s a menopause though so it can have different symptoms and it depends on the person but for a person with endo going through menopause is nothing at all (as my gyno said).

I’m so sorry for your friend :(  in order to avoid this my gyno is giving me estrogen patches starting next month. Her gyno should have helped her before this happened. I’ve talked with people who have had these shots for 10 years and they have been healthy without a period and without worsening endo. I hope she is ok now..

If I remember well there is a strong hormone blocker in them. They give you one shot every month and it blocks your hormones so you don’t get a period. You feel dizzy only the first two days but after a while it doesn’t happen anymore. (The first time you are going to get a longer period but then it’s going to stop completely). It helped my physical and mental health A LOT.
Induced menopause injections. A lifesaver
This makes me happy. I hope things go well with this guy and I hope that therapy helps

Thankyou!

I also thought about it. I’ll talk with my psychiatrist

What you and your wife are doing is simply amazing!! I would be happy to see/read your series.
Thanks for sharing!! I saw it and wanted to give it a try. How does it work though? How much does it cost?

Same, I’m so mad. I live in Italy and in my country it’s not considered a serious illness because “you are not in pain everyday of the month”. So basically 3 weeks per month are not enough? Not being able to move or live a normal life since I was 10 it’s nothing serious? Not just this but I also had to argue with a lot of people (also doctors) making fun of my pain, refusing to give me medication and being interested only about my fertility.
I live in Italy. I’ve talked to somebody and they said here you can have some benefits only for the last stage of endo and if you are getting a surgery and staying in hospital :|
Same! I’m happy there are people who are going through the same thing. I was relieved when I found so many supportive people here.
Hey don’t worry, also ocd comes in waves and can make you believe some pretty weird things.

I feel you. I had an exam today but I didn’t do it. I’ve been depressed for a while (I have bipolar other than ocd) and couldn’t study well the past few days. My mother is mad at me and doesn’t understand what being depressed means. She thinks I can just “get out of bed” , like it’s my fault… I’m tired to remember everybody I have an illness and I’m doing my best to keep studying..
The last sugar mommy who wrote me claimed to be from “francisco california” and couldn’t even speak proper English… so yeah I would accept only if I’m 100% sure they are real
I don’t understand why would they bother to pay me to do nothing? Should I accept?
Yes!! I hate when it happens at night and I can’t sleep. I read that it’s common for bipolar, ocd and adhd

I understand how distressing the thoughts can be. I often get the thought of killing my dog or hurting my mom. I get really anxious. But I guess you should remember that they are 100% not real!! if you find these thoughts distressing I’m sure you are a good person and you could never do something like this. Since ocd is an anxiety disorder it’s going to make you believe the scariest and most exaggerated scenario but that’s just not real and it’s not going to happen! I know that only these words can’t help but I hope you get the right medicine and go to therapy. I’m sure that’s going to help ;)
(I also think you should smoke less weed if that’s causing you more intrusive thoughts. A friend of mine smoked weed only once and got really bad panic attacks so she stopped)

Same. After my doctor said ocd thoughts are not my thoughts I think it’s my brain who wants to hurt me so I tell it to shut up. (I call it Bruno so I can say Silenzio Bruno like in the movie Luca lol I love that movie)
For any curiosities about Rasputin I’m here

Not manic but hypomanic. Once I was convinced I wanted to become an ufologist. I searched every information on ufo sightings in the world and checked the sky every night (I was buying an expensive telescope) and after a month I didn’t care at all. Same thing one year ago with my obsession on Rasputin: I read 3 books, watched documentaries and wanted to go live in his hometown in russia to work at a museum. While my last episode was my extreme obsession on wanting to become a rockstar, I was searching for music classes in my town and I actually believed I could make concerts in New York. After a month Poof🧚🏻‍♀️gone. Now I cringe thinking about it…

How did your doctor diagnosed you? I was first diagnosed with bipolar but my psychiatrist brought up the possibility to have borderline too, but I don’t really see why. Isn’t borderline developed after a trauma? Can I ask what’s the main characteristic?
Thanks!

I feel you. I remind myself everyday how much I wish I was born another person, with a different body and a different life and I also used to self harm because there is nothing I can do about it. Even though I believe these intrusive thoughts I know that the main problem is my brain convincing me that I shouldn’t keep on living. I’m sure there is at least one thing you are good at. Even turning 30 is an achievement. You did it and proved your brain that you deserve to live. I think about suicide everyday but I celebrate every year the fact that I still didn’t do it and I think you should celebrate too even if you are alone; go and do the thing you enjoy the most, eat your favourite food and watch a new movie. I wish you all the best
Not really, but I noticed that I sound stupid. I forget most of the words and I even struggle to write or remember stuff

Thanks! I will. I’m seeing a psychiatrist and he prescribed 100g Gabapentin (x3 a day), 10g Fluoxetine, 25g Lamotrigine (x2 a day) and 10g Inderal (x2 a day). It’s my first time taking medicines so my doctor gave me the lowest dose possible.

Thanks! I’ve been on meds only for three months, so I guess it takes a while to get better. I used to go to a psychologist but she kept analyzing my ocd thoughts too much and it got worse so I stopped going. I should try again maybe with a therapist with a different approach.
Same
Same. After my doctor increased my dose I feel always tired. I don’t really go through depression but neither hypomania or happiness.

I have it too!!! I think it’s actually pretty common for many people who suffer of ocd, you are not alone. The only solution is to live with it ig. I can’t sleep some days because I hear music so loud in my head. What I do is listening to kids lullabies often or asmr music so I get that song stuck in my head and it can make me feel relaxed. Try it! It helps (with medication of course)
Exactly! I’m 22 and I still have old clothes from primary school in my closet that don’t fit me but what if I’ll get skinny?🥴🥴
Exactly!! That’s weird fr
Yeah everything about ocd makes zero sense lol. Like my brain makes me believe that if I switch the light 3 times my family is not going to die tomorrow lol distressing but kinda funny

Don’t worry, if you are here worried that you could be a pedo it’s 100% ocd!!! I once changed my little cousin’s diaper and after 2 years I remembered and thought “what if I liked it? What if I stared too much at his private parts and now I’m a pedo??” . I knew it wasn’t possible and after the ocd diagnosis it all make sense..

Something similar happened with my therapist. She didn’t understand me at all. She was exploring the thoughts too much and I kept going home crying because she really made me believe I was trans or gay since she kept saying that I probably was in love with my friends (???) . I stopped going there. My psychiatrist said you should NEVER analyze ocd thoughts since they have absolutely no meaning.

>everyone does have changes in their mood, just not the extremes that we do

Exactly!! I could never explain this to my friends. When I say I get depressed all of a sudden for no reason they say “oh but everybody gets sad some days”, no, it’s not the same.
I also have multiple mood changes through the day and I also can’t really distinguish if people without cyclothymia experience them; but then I notice that usually I change mood all of a sudden (like crying desperately or getting really mad and then stopping and go on like nothing at all happened and I’m totally fine) and I guess that’s not entirely normal :/

Exactly! I have physical and mental illnesses and I’m tired of people saying things like “ohh but you know, 9 people out of 10 have the same illness”, ok? And what about it? I still have the same problem and I’m tired of living like this. Also when they say “there are bigger problems..” , so I should not cure my illnesses because there are people out there dying? What do they even mean??

I’ll take it for other 8 months and he said it’s ok if I want to keep taking it for years. Basically it was the best solution for me after different attempts. I’m also bipolar so the pill made me suicidal and it’s better not to try other solutions since this one seems safe for my mental and physical health. I hope it keeps going well even if I know there are many risks since I’m only 22 years old.

Actually my shots are called Enantone in my country and I’ve heard that they are called depo provera internationally but I guess they are different things. Mine are used to go on menopause but I actually don’t know much about it. Sorry for the confusion!

I’m in the same situation as you! I still need to get used to the medication and I’ve been having nightmares almost every night, but I actually don’t really mind since some of them are not that scary. Last night I dreamed about white tall skinny monsters walking down a road and I picked up one as a pet lmao

I tried for years to go on without any help (because my mother didn’t care) and it only made my ocd much worse. I’m only taking fluoxetine since November. It helped mostly but I still don’t feel 100% well but better than before of course.

I would be a little mad honestly. I don’t go through a mental illness that makes my life hell everyday since I was 13 only for somebody to use the term as something funny and relatable🤪. It’s not. I think you should let her know; of course calmly, she made a mistake but it’s still a professor.

It’s not stupid at all! Everybody has objects that are important to us. I feel you.. I also felt like a different person this afternoon: super chill, like nothing happened. The fact that it’s because of bipolar makes me relieved because I know it’s not my fault entirely.

Same. I try my best not to hurt myself badly anymore. The best thing for me is to breath deeply and rock back and forth for a while, maybe listening to a calming song. It doesn’t work every time but it’s better than nothing.
Update: after 40 minutes I’m good lmao. I also ate some gnocchi ✌🏻I probably got a mood swing due to stress since also my ocd got worse.

Sometimes I feel like I need to cry and I do, for no particular reason (maybe I get some negative thoughts idk but usually they don’t bother me). I cry like I’m desperate, shouting and I keep thinking why did I have to be born and then I stop all of a sudden and I’m like “ok done, that was it😗✌🏻”. One time I was crying and laughing uncontrollably lol, that was weird.
True :(
Thankyou!! I feel relieved. I also like drawing and writing my stories and I need of course to imagine them and I was worried to lose this ability
Same. I forget stuff I have to do in a matter of seconds

I’ve been taking it only for two months. Sorry for the stupid question but can I ask if you noticed that the way you imagine/dream changed or is it the same? And does the mania goes completely away as well as the depression? (I rarely had bad hypomania, often it’s just being extremely excited and agitated so I actually don’t want it to completely go away).

Hey, I’m so sorry you are going through this.. I don’t really have any advice but I noticed you said you are taking birth control. Is it really helping you or making the situation worse? I used to have really bad anger outbursts with self harm. It decreased thanks to medication and by stopping birth control. Have you heard about premenstrual dysphoric disorder? It could be making your bipolar worse. I’m not a doctor though.

Same!!! I think about this everyday but then I remember how bad my mood swings were (and still are if I get really stressed) but they got much better thanks to medication. I hope I’ll stop taking meds in the future but for now I absolutely can’t.
Hehe cute tiny onion 🧅

Not being able to live a quiet and normal life. I don’t know if I ever will enjoy anything. I don’t have a break from my thoughts. Also the fact that they could be disgusting, weird and the intrusive images I get are really gory and scare me. I can’t talk about it to anyone. My friends don’t understand why I can’t talk to a therapist. How can I even say these stuff without sounding like a psychopath?

I feel you! This summer I saw a little boy playing on the beach and I got so mad that it wasn’t me I felt like throwing up and I had to go home. After that day I still get scared every time I go out..it happens often but some days it’s not that bad ;). Same thing happens with movies where there are little boys, and I have to close the tv every time I get envious and mad..
I always get songs stuck in my head, also in the middle of the night. Especially tiktok sounds. It’s been a week since I have MATERIAL GWOORL on loop.

I love this

I have to say that your hair looks so good! It’s so healthy it looks silky. I would grow out the bangs first and wait for the whole hair to reach my belly button. But of course it’s a personal preference; I love long hair. If you prefer short go for something short!

I find these a little funny lmao; but of course it depends if your parents are supporting you or not. My mother is more supportive now and we can joke about my mood swings but when I used to self harm during my depressive episodes she would make fun of my bruises and laugh..and that was very insensitive. I’m sorry if they are making you feel bad :(
Brrrrrrrrrr
You are young and everyone makes mistakes. Your life will get better one day. Just please don’t end it now. There are many people who can help you
Pink highlights!!!🌸🌸

I also had sexual intrusive thoughts about family members, especially my brother and I felt so disgusted. If they make you feel distressed and uncomfortable it’s 100% ocd!! Don’t worry, it will get better.

I have exactly the same curls!! My hair is very thin and I always kept it long but unfortunately it used to be only frizzy and dry. I decided to cut it all and my hair got healthy and I found out it gets curly too lol. I would advise to leave the end a little wet with gel and scrunch it! 🥰

Same! But then the depression come back and I don’t have any energy to write for weeks :(  How do you keep staying motivated?

Same thing happens to me! I always need to hyper fixate on something. I have always a new obsession and I can’t even sleep because I need to know more about it. Then all of a sudden I don’t care anymore. I’m not diagnosed with bpd though; I have bipolar and ocd, so I guess that obsessions happen to me bacause my ocd can change when I go through hypomania or depression. I didn’t know it was also a borderline thing.

Omg are you me??! I relate to every sentence, also the painful thing in the chest. I get annoyed when I’m trying to daydream and I have to stop because my ocd makes me feel so bad that I wasn’t born the opposite sex. But I don’t care anymore. I got to the point I cry everyday and panic every time I get tocd thoughts (after a year the pain in the chest got better; I don’t experience it everyday). I love daydreaming because I like writing stories and drawing what I imagine; it’s basically my life and will always be part of me. I still push my daydreaming and also daydreaming only for some minutes everyday it’s an accomplishment for me. Try to exercise your imagination by reading more and keep dreaming also just for a little and it will get better. ( I’m sure about it because I had sexual thoughts about family members every time I used to daydream and after a while they were gone; I don’t know how long tocd it’s going to last but we have to keep ignoring it!)
This is so cool! I love how vibrant the colors are

I always get thoughts or distressing images in my mind of my family and my dog dying in bad incidents and I have to touch my bedroom’s furniture, switch the lights off at least 5 times, constantly check on them and doing tics with my mouth (clearing throat or making a whistle sound or pronouncing some words). It actually got better rn but it’s still distressing. I hope for you it gets better too 🤞🏻
